properties.title: Recommended reconstructed Norman Gournay holdings overlays
properties.coordinate_reference_system: WGS84 / RFC 7946 GeoJSON; coordinates are [longitude, latitude]
properties.usage_note: Historical research aid only. Polygons are interpretive, approximate modern-reference reconstructions; not surveyed medieval boundaries.
properties.derivation_summary: Built from the repo's Hugh de Gournay reconstruction plus additional point buffers for Gournay, La Ferté, Gaillefontaine, Sigy, Fry, Montigny-sur-Andelle, and Écouché. Buffers are deliberately conservative and labeled with confidence.

properties.name: Older Gournay core (repo reconstruction)
properties.historical_basis: Existing repo reconstruction for older Gournay lordship west/immediately around the Epte.
properties.interpretation_note: Approximate modern-reference visualization; not a surveyed medieval boundary.

properties.name: Beauvaisis acquisitions / Conquêts Hue de Gournay (repo reconstruction)
properties.historical_basis: Existing repo reconstruction from preserved Conquêts Hue de Gournay place-list and modern commune anchors.
properties.interpretation_note: Core polygon for the 24-village customary-law/acquisition block; not cadastral.

properties.name: Beauvaisis acquisitions expanded village-land buffer (3 km)
properties.historical_basis: Derived from existing 24-village polygon buffered by 3 km to represent village-field/parish/hamlet lands around listed settlements.
properties.interpretation_note: Use as expanded influence zone, not as a boundary.

properties.name: Gournay–La Ferté–Gaillefontaine frontier corridor estimate
properties.buffer_meters: 5000 along castle corridor; 2500 along Sigy/Fry ecclesiastical spur
properties.historical_basis: Derived from high-priority castle/landholding nodes: Gournay, La Ferté, Gaillefontaine, plus Sigy and Fry as cadet-line ecclesiastical sites.
properties.interpretation_note: Best used as an estimated frontier-holdings corridor, not a contiguous legal boundary.

properties.name: Pays de Bray / Gournay frontier context envelope
properties.historical_basis: Convex/context envelope around Gournay frontier corridor and Beauvaisis acquisitions; provided only as a regional interpretive frame.
properties.interpretation_note: Do not use as a landholding boundary. Use to show the geographic relationship of the Bray frontier sites.

properties.name: Norman Gournay landholding network envelope (low-confidence composite)
properties.historical_basis: Union of the Gournay frontier corridor, expanded Beauvaisis acquisitions, Montigny parage buffer, and Écouché maritagium/estate buffer.
properties.interpretation_note: This is not a claim of continuous landholding. It is a network envelope containing non-contiguous holdings and proof-places.

properties.name: Epte frontier line (schematic)
properties.historical_basis: Existing repo schematic line for the Epte frontier.
properties.interpretation_note: Orientation feature only; not an exact river trace.

properties.name: Gournay-en-Bray core buffer
properties.historical_basis: Derived circular buffer around a high-priority point/site.
properties.interpretation_note: Estimated 4 km buffer around the town/honor anchor; reflects surrounding landholding context, not a boundary.

properties.name: La Ferté castle/locality buffer
properties.historical_basis: Derived circular buffer around a high-priority point/site.
properties.interpretation_note: Estimated 3 km buffer around the La Ferté motte/locality; represents local cadet-line seat context.

properties.name: Gaillefontaine motte/domain buffer
properties.historical_basis: Derived circular buffer around a high-priority point/site.
properties.interpretation_note: Estimated 4 km buffer around Gaillefontaine motte/domain; represents frontier castle/domain context.

properties.name: Sigy abbey/church buffer
properties.historical_basis: Derived circular buffer around a high-priority point/site.
properties.interpretation_note: Estimated 2 km buffer around Sigy; ecclesiastical/cadet-line site context, not a secular jurisdiction.

properties.name: Fry Saint-Martin church buffer
properties.historical_basis: Derived circular buffer around a high-priority point/site.
properties.interpretation_note: Estimated 1.5 km buffer around Fry church; church/endowment context, not a confirmed parish boundary.

properties.name: Montigny-sur-Andelle parage buffer
properties.historical_basis: Derived circular buffer around a high-priority point/site.
properties.interpretation_note: Estimated 3 km buffer around Montigny parage proof-place; modern identity/fief extent needs verification.

properties.name: Écouché maritagium/estate buffer
properties.historical_basis: Derived circular buffer around a high-priority point/site.
properties.interpretation_note: Estimated 2.5 km buffer around Écouché locality; exact Gournay/Flaitel estate footprint not identified.
